lines.en:
Still alive, huh?
Hey, scumbag, I'm talkin' to you!
Have it your way, traitor.  You keep not talkin' and I'll keep pummellin' ya.
Heh heh.  Y'know, I'm just doin me job.  If you starve to death down here, it don't matter much to me.  Sleep tight, prisoner.
What the...  You can't come down here!
Barbaric.  How long have they let you languish in here?!
lines.zh: 真是残暴啊。 他们让你在这里受苦多久了？！

lines.en: Do not worry, my boy.  I know what they did to you.  We won't let them get away with it.
lines.zh: 别担心，我的孩子。 我知道他们对你做了些什么。 我们不会让他们逃脱惩罚的。

lines.en: Edmund Pendergast, financier!  I hope you've heard the name?
lines.zh: 埃德蒙·潘德加斯特，金融家！ 或许你曾经听说过这个名字？

lines.en: Yeah, you've got some money, they say.  So what do I matter to a man like you?
lines.zh: 是，他们说你很是有些钱。 所以我对您这样的人又有什么用处呢？
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: Just know that I am a friend, and frankly, you could use one right now.  You'll know what you need to know in time.  You two, get him out of those chains.
lines.zh: 你只要知道我是你的朋友就够了。而且说真的，你现在明显需要一位。 时机合适时，你会知道必要的事情的。 你们两个，把他身上的链子解开。
